name: Asmodeus
description: The evil spirit who killed Sara's seven husbands before they had lain with her; driven away by the smoke of a fish's heart and liver and bound by Raphael, and fled into the utmost parts of Egypt

points: Because that she had been married to seven husbands, whom Asmodeus the evil spirit had killed: the demon had killed.

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org
